en: Theragāthā 2.33 Dukanipāta, Catutthavagga The Elder’s Verses 2.33 The Second Book of Pairs, The Fourth Chapter: The Chapter on the Elder Sāḷha Sāḷha Thera 1. "I have crossed over the flood; I am free from all bonds. I have reached the further shore; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 2. "I have cut off craving at its root; I have shattered the thicket of views. I have abandoned all attachments; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 3. "I have destroyed the darkness; I have brought forth the light. I have reached the deathless state; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 4. "I have transcended birth and old age; I have put an end to suffering. I have realized the goal of the holy life; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 5. "I have no more rebirths; my mind is well-liberated. I have reached the final body; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 6. "I have seen the Dhamma with my own eyes; I have realized it for myself. I have no more doubts; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 7. "I have reached the unshakable state; I am free from all defilements. I have attained the peace of the heart; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 8. "I have reached the island of safety; I have crossed over the ocean of existence. I have reached the end of the journey; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 9. "I have reached the city of peace; I have entered the cool grove. I have reached the state beyond fear; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 10. "I have reached the realm of the noble ones; I have attained the fruit of the path. I have reached the supreme security; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 11. "I have reached the state of the Tathāgata; I have become an Arhat. I have reached the goal of the Buddhas; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 12. "I have reached the state of the Well-Gone One; I have become a Conqueror. I have reached the goal of the Victors; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 13. "I have reached the state of the Self-Enlightened One;

I have become a Pacceka-Buddha. I have reached the goal of the Solitary Buddhas; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 14. "I have reached the state of the Teacher; I have become a Buddha. I have reached the goal of the Buddhas; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 15. "I have reached the state of the Sage; I have become a Muni. I have reached the goal of the Sages; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 16. "I have reached the state of the Arahant; I have become a Worthy One. I have reached the goal of the Worthy Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 17. "I have reached the state of the Liberated One; I have become a Vimutta. I have reached the goal of the Liberated Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 18. "I have reached the state of the Peaceful One; I have become a Khema. I have reached the goal of the Peaceful Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 19. "I have reached the state of the Cool One; I have become a Sītibhūta. I have reached the goal of the Cool Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 20. "I have reached the state of the Stainless One; I have become a Vimala. I have reached the goal of the Stainless Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 21. "I have reached the state of the Pure One; I have become a Sucitta. I have reached the goal of the Pure Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 22. "I have reached the state of the Spotless One; I have become a Viraja. I have reached the goal of the Spotless Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 23. "I have reached the state of the Bright One; I have become a Jotin. I have reached the goal of the Bright Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 24. "I have reached the state of the Radiant One; I have become a Pabhassara. I have reached the goal of the Radiant Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 25. "I have reached the state of the Unblemished One; I have become a Anangaṇa. I have reached the goal of the Unblemished Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 26. "I have reached the state of the Unstained One; I have become a Asaṅkiliṭṭha. I have reached the goal of the Unstained Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 27. "I have reached the state of the Unattached One; I have become a Asaṃsaṭṭha. I have reached the goal of the Unattached Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 28. "I have reached the state of the Unbound One; I have become a Appaṭibaddha. I have reached the goal of the Unbound Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 29. "I have reached the state of the Unfettered One; I have become a Appaṭimukkha. I have reached the goal of the Unfettered Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 30. "I have reached the state of the Unobstructed One; I have become a Appaṭihata. I have reached the goal of the Unobstructed Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 31. "I have reached the state of the Unimpeded One; I have become a Appaṭividdha. I have reached the goal of the Unimpeded Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 32. "I have reached the state of the Unconquered One; I have become a Apparājita. I have reached the goal of the Unconquered Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 33. "I have reached the state of the Unvanquished One; I have become a Aparājita. I have reached the goal of the Unvanquished Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 34. "I have reached the state of the Unassailable One; I have become a Anabhibhūta. I have reached the goal of the Unassailable Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 35. "I have reached the state of the Unshakeable One; I have become a Akampiya. I have reached the goal of the Unshakeable Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 36. "I have reached the state of the Unwavering One; I have become a Acala. I have reached the goal of the Unwavering Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 37. "I have reached the state of the Unperturbed One; I have become a Avikampiya. I have reached the goal of the Unperturbed Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 38. "I have reached the state of the Unagitated One; I have become a Anuddhata. I have reached the goal of the Unagitated Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 39. "I have reached the state of the Unruffled One; I have become a Anuddhata. I have reached the goal of the Unruffled Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 40. "I have reached the state of the Unexcited One; I have become a Anunnata. I have reached the goal of the Unexcited Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna. 41. "I have reached the state of the Unelated One; I have become a Anomatta. I have reached the goal of the Unelated Ones; I am one who has attained Nibbāna."
The Verse of the Elder Upavāna:
“The Worthy One, the Sugata in the world,
the Sage, was afflicted by wind.”
O brahmin, give it to the Sage;
he is the one among those worthy of honor who should be honored.
Having been honored by those who honor,
and revered by those who revere,
I wish for him to pass away.
